Everyday life.clue: You hold this above your head when water falls from the sky. It keeps your clothes dry.
This is soft. You put it under your head at night to get comfortable.
You can see your own face in this. There is often one in the bathroom.

Food.clue: This round, flat food is cooked in a pan. People often eat a stack of them in the morning.
This is like an orange, but its skin is a different color. You can squeeze it into tea.
This is a common lunch you can hold in your hands. Cheese or meat goes in the middle.

Travel.clue: You show this small book when you arrive somewhere far from home. It has your photo and name inside.
This is a large bag you take on a trip. It often has wheels and a handle.
You go here before you travel through the sky. People check in and wait at a gate.

Nature.clue: You can see this where a stream drops over the edge of a cliff. It can be very loud.
This looks like a big curved line. You might see it when the sun comes out during a shower.
This is a tall landform with an opening at the top. Hot rock can come out of it.

Work and study.clue: You carry this to class to keep ideas in one place. It is empty when you first buy it.
This tells you when you must finish a task. Your teacher might give you one for an essay.
This is a quiet place where you can study. You can take things home for a few weeks and then return them.

Technology.clue: This sits on your desk and has lots of buttons. Each button can put a letter on the screen.
You connect this to your phone when it is almost empty. Soon you can use your phone again.
You wear these so you can hear a video without other people hearing it too.
